Text.Text: I am Sergeant Varn Tolek of the starport garrison. The Sith Lords want the wastes kept quiet, and they leave the work to me. I pay outsiders who are willing to help with it.
Good work. The supply road is usable again, and the garrison pays for results. Here is your pay.
You are back, and the last convoy came in on time. Did you kill all twelve Pelko Bug Swarms?

Pelko Bug Swarms have settled along the starport's supply road. They get into the rations, the filters and my troopers' helmets, and every convoy arrives late. I need you to kill twelve Pelko Bug Swarms in the Wastelands, the Ravine or the Dunes. Report back to me here when it is done and the garrison will pay you.
Good. Kill twelve Pelko Bug Swarms in the Wastelands, the Ravine or the Dunes on Korriban, then come back to me here.
You still need to kill twelve Pelko Bug Swarms in the Wastelands, the Ravine or the Dunes on Korriban. Come back to me when it is done.
Then the short route is open again. The Sith Lords will not notice, but my patrols will. Here is your pay.
You are back from the Ravine, and my patrol reported in with every trooper alive. Did you kill all ten Moraband Serpents?

The Ravine is the shortest route from the starport to the tombs, and it is full of Moraband Serpents. My last patrol went in with six troopers and came out with four. I need you to kill ten Moraband Serpents in the Ravine or the Caverns. Come back to me here when it is done and I will pay you.
Good. Kill ten Moraband Serpents in the Ravine or the Caverns on Korriban, then come back to me here.
You still need to kill ten Moraband Serpents in the Ravine or the Caverns on Korriban. Come back to me when it is done.
Good. Here is your pay. Do not tell anyone what the garrison keeps stored down there.
You are back, and my munitions detail came out of the Caverns carrying crates. Did you kill all ten Shyrack?

The garrison stores its munitions in the Caverns, where the heat cannot reach them. The Shyrack have moved back in, and my troopers can no longer get to their own stores. I need you to go into the Caverns and kill ten Shyrack. Come back to me here when it is done and I will pay you.
Good. Kill ten Shyrack in the Caverns on Korriban, then come back to me here.
You still need to kill ten Shyrack in the Caverns on Korriban. Come back to me when it is done.
That is a week of patrols I will not have to bury. Here is your pay, at the hazard rate.
You are back. The Dunes patrol brought in a tooth as long as my arm. Did you kill all eight Wraid?

The Wraid are the worst of them. They are armored, as large as a speeder truck, and they charge anything that crosses the Dunes. I lose troopers to them every week. I need you to kill eight Wraid in the Dunes. Come back to me here when it is done and I will pay you the hazard rate.
Good. Kill eight Wraid in the Dunes on Korriban, then come back to me here.
You still need to kill eight Wraid in the Dunes on Korriban. Come back to me when it is done.
Then the patrol is done. Here is a trooper's rate. The same work is here whenever you want it again.
You are back from the Wastelands and still standing. Did you kill ten Pelko Bug Swarms and ten K'lor'slugs?

It does, and the work never runs out. The Wastelands fill up with vermin as fast as my troopers clear them. One patrol means killing ten Pelko Bug Swarms and ten K'lor'slugs in the Wastelands. Report back to me here afterwards and I will pay you a trooper's rate. You can take a patrol as often as you like.
Good. Kill ten Pelko Bug Swarms and ten K'lor'slugs in the Wastelands on Korriban, then come back to me here.
You still need to kill ten Pelko Bug Swarms and ten K'lor'slugs in the Wastelands on Korriban. Come back to me when it is done.
It is good ore. Here is your pay, at the materials rate. The Empire will never know it paid for this.
You are back, and the armorer has already started work on the ore. Is that everything I asked you for?

We are short of armor plate. Every Wraid charge ruins a suit, and the Empire ships new armor to its fleets, not to garrisons. My armorer can make repairs if he has ore. I need you to mine eight Raw Plagionite and eight Raw Scordspar in the Caverns or the Dunes and bring them to me here.
Good. Mine eight Raw Plagionite and eight Raw Scordspar in the Caverns or the Dunes, then bring them to me here.
I still need eight Raw Plagionite and eight Raw Scordspar. You can mine both in the Caverns or the Dunes. Bring them to me when you have them all.
Goodbye, Sergeant.
What other work does the garrison have for me?
Yes, all twelve swarms are destroyed.
I will come back.
On my way.
I'll do it. I will kill twelve Pelko Bug Swarms.
No, clearing out bugs is not work for me.
What is wrong with the starport's supply road?
Still working on it.
Remind me what you need done about the Pelko Bug Swarms.
Yes, all ten serpents are dead.
I will come back.
On my way.
I'll take the job. I will kill ten Moraband Serpents.
No, your patrols can take the long way around.
What is killing your patrols in the Ravine?
Still working on it.
Remind me what you need done about the Moraband Serpents.
Yes, all ten Shyrack are dead.
I will come back.
On my way.
I'll do it. I will kill ten Shyrack in the Caverns.
No, I would rather stay out of the caves.
Does the garrison still use the Caverns?
Still working on it.
Remind me what you need done about the Shyrack.
Yes, all eight Wraid are dead.
I will come back.
On my way.
I'll take the job. I will kill eight Wraid.
No, that sounds like a job for a tank.
What is the most dangerous beast in the wastes?
Still working on it.
Remind me what you need done about the Wraid.
Yes, I killed ten of each.
I will come back.
On my way.
I'll take a patrol. Ten swarms and ten K'lor'slugs.
No, I can't take a patrol today.
Does the garrison pay for patrols of the Wastelands?
Still working on it.
Remind me what the Wastelands patrol involves.
Yes, that was all sixteen pieces of ore.
I will come back.
On my way.
I'll do it. Eight Raw Plagionite and eight Raw Scordspar.
No, I am not a miner.
Is the garrison short of any supplies?
I have everything you asked for.
I do not have it all yet.
Remind me about the Raw Plagionite you wanted.
